description: Register a domain for certificate issuance and start its DCV (Certificate Manager 2.0). dcvType PTXT = set the DNS TXT record once and reuse it; TXT = a new record per issuance. Public zone only. Requires a main-account API key — Certificate Manager 2.0 rejects Sub Account keys with HTTP 403 (confirmed by Ncloud support; verified 2026-10-02 with NCP_ADMINISTRATOR).

dcvType.description: DCV type: PTXT (persistent TXT) or TXT (per-issuance TXT)

issueType.description: How certificates for this domain are issued: CONSOLE or ACME

name: ncloud_cm2_register_domain
